description: Fetch one public web page politely (checks robots.txt first and refuses disallowed paths; identifies itself as MoneyMakerBot) and return status, final URL after redirects, title, language, meta description, canonical, favicon, Open Graph/Twitter tags, JSON-LD types, h1-h3 outline, link counts with a sample, and the readable text of <main>/<article>/<body> (scripts and styles stripped, up to max_chars, default 20,000). No JavaScript rendering. Private hosts are refused. Failed fetches return an error status, so x402 clients are not charged. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/web-extract.
name: web_extract
title: Web page extract: title, meta, OG, headings, links, readable text
